scope: Genesis Generative Kernel, Asset Trunk adapters, renderers, browser presentation runtime, and future recipe-aware portable state.

laws.name: RECIPE_NE_ARBITRARY_CODE
laws.statement: A Genesis recipe is bounded declarative data, never executable arbitrary code.
laws.enforcement: Schema allowlists, bounded parameters, no eval/Function/dynamic module execution.

laws.name: GENERATED_CONTENT_NE_STORED_ASSET
laws.statement: Reproducible generated content may be represented by generator identity, recipe, parameters, seed, input hashes, and provenance instead of only rendered bytes.
laws.enforcement: Portable state prefers causes; rendered caches are disposable derivatives.

laws.name: RENDERER_NE_AUTHORITY
laws.statement: A renderer or presentation forge cannot become authoritative world state merely by rendering or sounding an event.
laws.enforcement: Presentation outputs are downstream of canonical state and carry presentation_only=true.

laws.name: WORLD_STATE_TO_PRESENTATION_ALLOWED
laws.statement: Explicit bounded canonical world fields may modulate presentation generators.
laws.enforcement: Each forge declares an allowlist of world bindings and clamps all values.

laws.name: PRESENTATION_TO_WORLD_MUTATION_DEFAULT_DENY
laws.statement: Audio, visual, material, mesh, effect, and scene renderers may not mutate canonical world state by default.
laws.enforcement: World mutation requires a separate authoritative state transition contract outside the renderer.

laws.name: HIDDEN_HUMAN_TELEMETRY_FORBIDDEN
laws.statement: Hidden human behavior, inferred psychology, vulnerability, or covert sensor telemetry cannot control Genesis generators.
laws.enforcement: Unknown telemetry fields fail closed; opt-in sensor adapters must be explicit and separately governed.

laws.name: EXPLICIT_USER_GESTURE_REQUIRED_FOR_BROWSER_AUDIO
laws.statement: Browser audio activation must originate from an explicit user gesture.
laws.enforcement: Audio Forge exposes enable() but the Pages control plane calls it only from a user control.

laws.name: SAME_RECIPE_SEED_VERSION_EQ_SAME_PLAN
laws.statement: For a deterministic forge, identical recipe, seed, generator version, bounded world inputs, and declared input hashes must produce the same generation plan.
laws.enforcement: Determinism is covered by forge-specific tests before promotion.

laws.name: PROVENANCE_REQUIRED
laws.statement: Every external source and every distilled/generated derivative must preserve source and generator provenance sufficient for audit.
laws.enforcement: Missing provenance blocks promotion into canonical asset or recipe registries.

laws.name: RIGHTS_FAIL_CLOSED_FOR_EXTERNAL_ASSETS
laws.statement: Unknown or incompatible rights metadata blocks external assets from the reusable Genesis reservoir.
laws.enforcement: Rights checks occur before reusable ingestion; uncertainty is not treated as permission.

laws.name: NO_BINARY_BYTES_OVER_SLIME
laws.statement: SLIME carries control-plane queries, pointers, receipts, rights, hashes, and provenance rather than bulk binary asset payloads.
laws.enforcement: Bulk bytes travel directly through approved provider/API/CDN paths into the Asset Reservoir.

laws.name: CONTENT_HASH_BINDS_DERIVATION
laws.statement: Generated or distilled derivatives must be bindable to their declared causes by content and recipe hashes.
laws.enforcement: Generator version, recipe identity, input hashes, parameters, and seed are retained with derivation receipts.

laws.name: GENERATOR_EXTERNAL_NETWORK_DEFAULT_DENY
laws.statement: Generative forge execution does not fetch arbitrary external network resources at generation time by default.
laws.enforcement: External acquisition belongs to explicit Asset Trunk adapters; the Pages shell may read only repository-published same-origin static contracts and runtime files.

laws.name: FREEZE_NE_IMMUTABILITY_WITHOUT_VERSION
laws.statement: A frozen law may be superseded only by an explicit versioned amendment; silent mutation is forbidden.
laws.enforcement: Any change requires a version bump, changelog rationale, tests, CI, and a reviewable pull request.
